question.worked_solution:
First, we apply the addition principle, subtracting $14$ from both sides:

$$
\begin{aligned}-1 & \le 5x+14 \\ -1-14 & \le 5x+14-14 \\ -15 & \le 5x+0 \\ -15 & \le 5x\end{aligned}
$$

Second, we apply the multiplication principle, dividing both sides by $5:$

$$
\begin{aligned}-15 & \le 5x \\ -\frac{15}{5} & \le \frac{5x}{5} \\ -3 & \le \frac{\cancel{5}x}{\cancel{5}} \\ -3 & \le x\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, let's swap the left and right-hand sides so that the variable is on the left-hand side. Remember, we also need to flip the inequality.

$$
x\ge -3
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x\ge -3.$
